subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: For this PR's internal generated-media wake-false path, should maintainers require stacked live gateway/Telegram proof before merge, or accept the scheduler tests plus internal Mantis manifest as sufficient proof?
rationale: The current code review can assess the policy split, but the external PR proof gate is unresolved because normal Telegram Desktop proof skipped the changed path and produced no visible artifact.

options.title: Require stacked live proof
options.body: Wait for the proof harness or stacked proof PR to show baseline/main missing or blocking the marker request and the candidate delivering exactly one generated media item.

options.title: Accept internal proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly override the live-proof gate if they decide this failure mode cannot reasonably be stimulated outside scheduler-level tests and the internal Mantis manifest.

recommendation.title: Require stacked live proof
recommendation.body: Wait for the proof harness or stacked proof PR to show baseline/main missing or blocking the marker request and the candidate delivering exactly one generated media item.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent media requester-route work and coauthorship on the delivery-route safety boundary make this the best available routing candidate for proof-sufficiency judgment.
